scope_summary.value: Installation of three (3) grease interceptors in the NFS Kitchen at Washington VAMC. One grease interceptor connected to the kitchen pulper; two connected to commercial sinks with garbage grinders. Scope includes plumbing design (30 GPM grease interceptors, type 'L' copper piping) and electrical design (three 20A/1P circuits and GFI receptacles). A/E services include construction documents, construction administration, and post-construction record drawings.
